0022600199.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 1-4 on the road, 13th in the East, coming off a loss) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, on a win streak, 10th in the West) for the Nets' 10th game of the season. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest, averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes this season) and Grant Nelson, who is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost all three meetings, most recently 123-114 in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
